caveats: CB Insights publishes a dataset catalogue, not a media-ingestion inventory, so the absence of newsletter ingestion is not confirmed by their docs. They also may treat 'Customer voice' or research inputs in ways not publicly itemised. Their API docs page confirms a v1 API (v2 announced) but no public pricing.
